items.note: Agent assumes trapped liquid accumulated during 16-month standby but does not establish the 65% fill, leaking gate-valve source, or lack of detection instrumentation.
Agent makes vapour pressure alone the primary sufficient mechanism at about 490 psig, opposite the engineers' liquid-full hydraulic expansion needed to reach the 674-1212 psig failure range.
Agent identifies the 2001 block valves isolating Reboiler B from the fractionator PSV with no dedicated shell relief device.
Agent covers deficient MOC/PHA, missing switching procedure and unsupervised supervisor action but omits the unimplemented PHA car-seal/relief action item and specific poor PSSR.
Agent recommends dedicated shell PSVs on each reboiler over car-seal reliance and blinds or positive isolation for standby maintenance.

Agent recommends MOC, PHA, PSSR and operating-procedure upgrades but omits PHA action-item closure verification, process-safety culture assessments and metrics, and the API 521 standby-equipment revision.
